summary: First-party English and local/native-language discovery identified HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE Index Polygons source. Its live WMS advertised CP.CadastralParcel and returned a bounded Walton extent with visible parcel boundaries and numeric labels. WFS was explicitly disabled and GetFeatureInfo was non-queryable, so no native ID-plus-geometry sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and bounded HTTP routes, statuses, endpoint configuration, CRS findings, and scratch evidence paths are recorded in city-5877-walton-on-thames.json.

custodians.name: HM Land Registry
custodians.scope: National registry/cadastre custodian for England and Wales; official INSPIRE index polygons and map service.

custodians.name: Surrey County Council
custodians.scope: Local map-document evidence only; no current parcel API or cadastral registry endpoint was established.
